subject: História
description_pt: Reconhecer os principais produtos, utilizados pelos europeus, procedentes do continente africano durante o imperialismo e analisar os impactos sobre as comunidades locais na forma de organização e exploração econômica.

components.description_pt: Identificar principais recursos naturais e produtos extraídos da África na era do imperialismo
components.description_en: Identify principal natural resources and products extracted from Africa during the age of imperialism

components.description_pt: Explicar como potências europeias exploravam recursos africanos no período imperialista
components.description_en: Explain how European powers exploited African resources during the imperialist period

components.description_pt: Analisar impacto da extração de recursos na organização social de comunidades africanas
components.description_en: Analyze the impact of resource extraction on the social organization of African communities
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

components.description_pt: Analisar consequências econômicas da exploração europeia para comunidades africanas locais
components.description_en: Analyze the economic consequences of European exploitation for local African communities
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between resource distribution and patterns of human economic or social development

cc_matches.description: All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.
Resource availability has guided the development of human society.
